headline: Obelisk the Tormentor
title: Obelisk the Tormentor Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Obelisk the Tormentor. What is it? It is an Egyptian God Card with four thousand attack and four thousand defense. What does it do? Neither player can target it with card effects. You can tribute two monsters to destroy all monsters your opponent controls, but then it cannot attack that turn. How do you use it? It needs three Tributes to Normal Summon. It is part of the 25th Anniversary Ultimate Kaiba Set. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
